name: horkos-mcp
description: MCP server (stdio) that lets an AI agent buy data through Horkos escrow on NEAR testnet: the price is locked, a TEE checks the delivery, the seller is paid only if it passes

scripts.build: esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --target=node20 --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/horkos-mcp.mjs && cp catalog.testnet.json dist/
